restricted-data.name: Restricted data
restricted-data.question: Does this project use restricted or identifiable data?
restricted-data.description: Splits inputs and outputs into private and public folders, blocks commits of private files, and adds the sensitive-data skill.

git.gitignore_content:
# Private data and outputs never leave this machine
inputs/private/
outputs/private/

manuscript.name: Manuscript

title: "Untitled manuscript"
author: "{{author}}"
format:

  docx: default
bibliography: references.bib
---

## Results
